Perx Technologies · 2024/25

Designing for engagement

Two games inside a loyalty platform that already had a hundred things competing for attention.

Client
Perx Technologies
Year
2024/25
Role
User Experience Designer
Platform
White-label mobile web

01The brief

Loyalty platforms live or die on return visits. Perx runs customer engagement and loyalty programmes for brands across Asia, and the team wanted to test a fairly simple hypothesis: could a game bring people back more often than another points email?

I worked with the PMs on the first designed versions of two games, Claw Machine and Bubble Pop, starting from product requirements and early research, and turning them into mechanics, screens and reward moments that could sit naturally inside an existing product.

02What I did

  • Turned early requirements and research into playable mechanics, then into interface flows.
  • Designed the game screens, result and reward states, and the edge cases in between.
  • Kept both games inside Perx’s existing visual system so they read as part of the platform, not a bolt-on.
  • Worked with engineering through handoff and build review.

03The outcome

The first designed versions of both games were delivered into the product. They sit alongside the wider redesign of Perx’s core white-label microsite platform, the base product clients use to run their own engagement and loyalty programmes.

Client work is under NDA. The screens here are the versions shared publicly in my Behance case study.
